children: Smith & Wesson Brands, Inc. reported first-quarter fiscal 2027 results with revenue of $112.6M, up from $85.1M a year earlier, and net income of $2.6M versus a loss in the prior-year quarter; diluted EPS was $0.06 for the quarter.
Revenue was $112.6M for Q1 FY2027 (three months ended July 31, 2026), compared with $85.1M in the year-ago quarter; YoY change 32.3%.
Net income was $2.6M for Q1 FY2027, compared with a net loss of $3.4M in the year-ago quarter (improvement of $6.0M).
Diluted earnings per share was $0.06 for Q1 FY2027, compared with $(0.08) in the year-ago quarter (change of $0.14).
Net sales rose 32.3% year over year to $112.6M, driven by higher demand and a premium product mix.
Channel and unit shifts: sporting goods channel handgun shipments increased 16.7%; professional channel handguns rose 45.5%.
Product momentum: newly introduced products represented 35.3% of net sales; new handguns accounted for 43.1% of handgun sales.
Operational capacity: inventory was increased to support level-loading production in anticipation of demand, and capital expenditures are ramping to expand capacity.
Margin drivers: gross margin improved to 28.7%, aided in part by a one-time tariff refund and higher production absorption.
